title: Evals in Production: Turning Human Verdicts Into a Score
description: I built an evaluation harness for the AI agent that picks my livestream clips, and the first thing its scores told me wasn't about the prompt at all.

I walk through the whole LangGraph pipeline at the code level, how every keep or kill at the human gate becomes a record, how old livestreams get replayed under a new prompt, and what 98 judged clips at 82.7 percent precision really say.
chapter_stamps: How the Harness Holds an Agent
Rules in Code, Not in the Prompt
